findings.nextAction: Adapt authoritative OSS package/result contracts at the existing executor boundary; do not rewrite public OSS DTO or merely prefix one hash.

findings.evidence: Executor forwards taskId only and shared baseDir. Bridge fallback uses baselineHash/taskId for snapshot rather than actual owned WP site. HTTP schema lacks baseRevision and profile ID is UUID.
findings.nextAction: Bind real authoritative task package and owned workspace/base snapshot before dispatch; owner must resolve HTTP contract deliberately.

findings.evidence: Internal mapper exists but has no non-test caller. Snapshot wrapper discards private artifactDirectory and generates toolExecutionId without exposing persisted binding to that folder.
findings.nextAction: Add scoped private frozen-artifact binding and a real manual_handoff/package/local WP/result/review integration test through existing OSS APIs; do not count this as automatic EXEC proof.

findings.evidence: Same workerRef claim can succeed with alreadyClaimed; worker ignores claim result and invokes executor again.
findings.reproduction: In an isolated owned queue, interrupt after first spawn and before result acceptance, then redeliver same job.id; measure actual delta-spawn. Required result is zero new spawn and reconciliation for uncertain execution.

findings.evidence: Resume only accepts signal count greater than zero; correlation lookup selects PAUSED instances. Redelivery after successful signal but before delivered write can receive zero and mark failure.
findings.reproduction: Interrupt isolated owned resume worker after workflow resumes and before mark_delivery; redeliver same job and record workflow state, completionDelivery and effective-resume count. Required final state is delivered with exactly one effective resume.

findings.evidence: Existing reservation replay returns immediately without recovering failed park/enqueue. Park failure can leave a reservation that a same-key retry does not resume.
